shape_list.name: Color

shape_list.name: Invert

shape_list.name: Source

shape_list.name: Planar-track

viewer_editing.name: Add point
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.mousePressEvent` → `Viewer._insert_roto_point`.

viewer_editing.name: Delete point
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.keyPressEvent` → `Viewer._delete_roto_points`.

viewer_editing.name: Move point
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.mousePressEvent`, `Viewer.mouseMoveEvent`, `Viewer._commit_roto_drag`.

viewer_editing.name: Select several points
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.mousePressEvent`, `_roto_box_result`; NodeBased uses Shift+LMB and box selection rather than Ctrl/Cmd+LMB/marquee.

viewer_editing.name: Select all points
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.keyPressEvent` Ctrl+A branch.

viewer_editing.name: Feather add
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.mousePressEvent` / feather-handle and Ctrl-drag branches; no E key.

viewer_editing.name: Feather drag
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.mousePressEvent` feather-handle branch; `Viewer._commit_roto_drag`.

viewer_editing.name: Feather reset
viewer_editing.location: `RotoPanel.build_panel` / `roto-reset-feather-points`; no Shift+E.

viewer_editing.name: Tangent create
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.mouseReleaseEvent` point-draw drag; `Viewer.finish_roto_draw`.

viewer_editing.name: Tangent move both
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.mouseMoveEvent` / tangent branch mirrors handles by default; Nuke Shift snaps opposite tangent lengths.

viewer_editing.name: Break tangent
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.mousePressEvent` tangent branch records Ctrl; `Viewer._commit_roto_drag`.

viewer_editing.name: Cusp point
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.keyPressEvent` Shift+Z → `Viewer._set_roto_tangent_mode(True)`.

viewer_editing.name: Smooth point
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.keyPressEvent` Z → `Viewer._set_roto_tangent_mode(False)`.

viewer_editing.name: Transform box
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer._roto_box_geometry`, `_roto_box_action`, `_roto_box_result`; no T toggle.

viewer_editing.name: Transform-box center/pivot
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer._roto_box_result`; `RotoPanel.build_panel` shape transform center controls; interaction differs from Nuke handles.

viewer_editing.name: Transform-box pivot modify
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer._roto_box_action`, `_roto_box_result`; Nuke Ctrl/Cmd+Shift handle gesture is absent.

viewer_editing.name: Nudge point
viewer_editing.location: No numeric-keypad nudge branch in `Viewer.keyPressEvent`.

viewer_editing.name: Draw Bezier/B-Spline freely
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.begin_roto_draw`, `Viewer.finish_roto_draw`; no Ctrl/Cmd sketch mode or B-Spline implementation.

viewer_editing.name: Bezier/B-Spline handles/tension
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.mouseReleaseEvent` drawing drag creates cubic handles; no B-Spline tension tool or Ctrl/Cmd+Alt tension drag.

viewer_editing.name: Sharp exit while drawing
viewer_editing.location: No Shift+LMB sharp-exit branch in `Viewer.mousePressEvent`.

viewer_editing.name: B-Spline tension
viewer_editing.location: No B-Spline model or tension interaction in Viewer code.

viewer_editing.name: Close shape
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.finish_roto_draw`, `Viewer.mouseReleaseEvent`; Enter/first point close, but shape-mode semantics differ.

viewer_editing.name: Leave shape open
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.keyPressEvent` Escape → `Viewer.cancel_roto_edit`; NodeBased cancels instead of committing an open spline.

viewer_editing.name: Tool change
viewer_editing.location: No Roto tool-mode group in Viewer to switch away while drawing.

viewer_editing.name: Escape to selection
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.keyPressEvent` Escape cancels Roto editing rather than switching to Select.

viewer_editing.name: Brush size
viewer_editing.location: `Window.build_node_panel` brush size field only; no Shift+drag resize in Viewer.

viewer_editing.name: Clone offset
viewer_editing.location: `Window.build_node_panel` Clone source offset fields; no Ctrl/Cmd+drag offset gesture.

viewer_editing.name: Reveal onion skin
viewer_editing.location: No onion-skin overlay in `Viewer.paint_overlays` or T binding in `Viewer.keyPressEvent`.

viewer_editing.name: Selection tool cycle
viewer_editing.location: No Q selection-mode cycle in `Viewer.keyPressEvent`.

viewer_editing.name: Tool mode cycle
viewer_editing.location: No S tool-mode cycle in `Viewer.keyPressEvent`.

viewer_editing.name: Paint tool cycles
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.keyPressEvent` handles B/E/C; other paint operations use `Window.build_node_panel` / `rotopaint-tool`.

timing_animation.name: Autokey
timing_animation.location: `Viewer._roto_scalar_at_frame`; no autokey toggle. New shapes are static; movement keys only if animation is present.

timing_animation.name: Delete key: spline
timing_animation.location: `Window.build_curve_menu` / Delete key at frame; `Window.make_key_button`. Key control presentation differs.

timing_animation.name: Set/delete point keys
timing_animation.location: `RotoPanel.build_panel` `key_shape` keys the selected shape’s point scalars together; no individual point key control.

timing_animation.name: Set key: transform
timing_animation.location: `RotoPanel.build_panel` per-transform key buttons; no RotoPaint spline-key control.

timing_animation.name: Lifetime endpoints
timing_animation.location: Roto shape lifetime start/end fields; RotoPaint panel exposes range endpoints, with different control placement.

timing_animation.name: Ripple editing
timing_animation.location: No ripple timing operation in `RotoPanel.build_panel` or `Window.build_node_panel`; Nuke chapter has no such workflow page.

timing_animation.name: Per-shape keyframe controls
timing_animation.location: `RotoPanel.build_panel` / shape key button and scalar key controls; no same selected-item key scope menu.

timing_animation.name: Motion blur keys
timing_animation.location: `RotoPanel.build_panel` / motion blur samples/shutter/offset controls; `Window.build_node_panel` selected-item fields.
